# pushward_org_route (Resource)

A routing rule: who receives the organization's activities, notifications or widgets whose slug matches. Rules are tried in order and the first match decides; with no match everyone receives it. A new rule goes after the existing ones, and `pushward_org_route_order` sets the order.

Every change takes effect at once: the server re-applies the rules to ongoing Live Activities itself, so there is no separate apply step.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Deploy activities and their notifications go to the on-call group and to
# devices tagged pager.
resource "pushward_org_route" "deploys" {
  slug_pattern    = "deploy-*"
  applies_to      = "both"
  allow_group_ids = [pushward_org_group.oncall.id]
  allow_tag_ids   = [pushward_org_tag.pager.id]
  note            = "Deploys go to on-call"
}

# Anything else reaches nobody but the group.
resource "pushward_org_route" "rest" {
  slug_pattern    = "*"
  applies_to      = "both"
  allow_group_ids = [pushward_org_group.oncall.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `applies_to` (String) `activities`, `notifications`, `both` (activities and notifications) or `widgets`.
- `slug_pattern` (String) `*`, a slug, or a slug prefix ending in `*`. Activities and widgets match their slug, notifications their `activity_slug`, else their source.

### Optional

- `allow_group_ids` (Set of String) Members of these groups receive what the rule matches. At most 50.
- `allow_tag_ids` (Set of String) Devices with these tags receive what the rule matches. At most 50. With both lists empty the rule reaches nobody.
- `note` (String) Up to 200 characters.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import pushward_org_route.deploys 2c8f4e6a-1b3d-4a7c-9e5f-8d0b6a4c2e17
```
